scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run start:dev -w @archblueprint/api" "npm run dev -w @archblueprint/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @archblueprint/web && npm run build -w @archblueprint/api
scripts.db:init: npm run prisma:generate -w @archblueprint/api && npm run db:migrate -w @archblueprint/api -- --name init && npm run db:seed -w @archblueprint/api
scripts.build:static: DATABASE_URL=file:./build.db npm run db:setup -w @archblueprint/api && DATABASE_URL=file:./build.db npm run export:static -w @archblueprint/api && npm run build:static -w @archblueprint/web
